items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Buddy used to use it. Buddy used his Durbin. Buddy and Chris Kelly, they believed in the Durbin.

ctx.x: You used a half of coconut too? Yeah, coconut, that would be a good. A lot of them used a half of coconut shell.
Buddy used to use it. Buddy used his Durbin. Buddy and Chris Kelly, they believed in the Durbin. I'm a Durbin man.
